additional_info.subject: 0420567 - ID0420567-DC/Si-D/SA-[Y2 / R4 312922184008] technical issue CRM:00314000231
additional_info.body:
Dear colleagues,
This morning I supported the onsite troubleshooting for ticket
ID0420567.
The charger
Dhijum
shows a black screen with back lightning. Today I supported the onsite troubleshooting instructions, as per Q-Feedback Q2302.
The DP cable was replaced, but did not solved the problem. DLogic FW process was initiated, but it was noticed that:
24V dc was arriving to the control board of HMI
LEDs were not turning on
Via teh Update program, the control board was not reachable. Error: Get Device Addr… Failure.
Because of the above points, the HMI needs to be replaced, since it shows a defect and an internal malfunctioning of the control board.
The HMI needs to be ordered and replaced:
The installed HMI is MLFB 8EM5903-0AA01-7AA0
The spare parts to be ordered are:
With kind regards,
